findings.message: Open Redirect vulnerability (CWE-601): User-controlled redirect target is returned in an HTTP redirect response without validating the URL scheme and network location (netloc), allowing attackers to redirect victims to external phishing domains via 'https://evil.com' or protocol-relative '//evil.com' URLs. Allow only safe relative internal paths starting with a single '/' and no external host/scheme.

 def build_post_login_redirect(next_url: str) -> Dict[str, Any]:
